 out=B/'main-cpu-optimization-full-build-and-lints-root-v2';assert not out.exists();out.mkdir()
 r=dict(active=True,complete=False,passed=False,commands=[],gpu_executed=False,source=ident(Path(__file__)),builds={},source_pins={})
 def save(): (out/'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
 owner=m.Owner(out/'commands',save);r['commands']=owner.commands;start=time.monotonic()

  c,so,se=owner.run(label,argv,env,cwd,wall=min(wall,left),cpu=wall*6,rss_cap=24<<30,text_cap=12<<20,total_cap=128<<20,file_cap=256<<20)

  assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed
  return c,so.read_text(),se.read_text()
 try:
  prior_p=B/'main-cpu-optimization-full-build-and-lints-root-v1/record.json'
  prior=json.loads(prior_p.read_text());assert not prior['passed'] and not prior['complete'] and not prior['active']
  assert all(m.closed(c) for c in prior['commands'])
  pins=dict(prior['source_pins']);assert all(m.sha(W/p)==digest for p,digest in pins.items())
  r['prior_failed_lint']=ident(prior_p);r['cpu_receipt']=prior['cpu_receipt']
  p=W/'CMakeLists.txt';s=p.read_text();assert s.count('tests/core/cpu_job_histogram_no_gpu.cpp tests/core/cpu_job_histogram_adapter.cpp)')==1
  p.write_text(s.replace('tests/core/cpu_job_histogram_no_gpu.cpp tests/core/cpu_job_histogram_adapter.cpp)','tests/core/cpu_job_histogram_no_gpu.cpp src/core/expert_source.cpp)'))

  for old,new in [('std::memcmp(&baseline[r], &candidate[r], sizeof(float))','std::bit_cast<uint32_t>(baseline[r]) != std::bit_cast<uint32_t>(candidate[r])'),('std::memcmp(saved.data(), candidate.data(), sizeof(candidate))','!same_bits(saved, candidate)'),('std::memcmp(baseline.data(), candidate.data(), sizeof(candidate))','!same_bits(baseline, candidate)')]:
   assert s.count(old)==1;s=s.replace(old,new)
  p.write_text(s);pins['tests/core/iq3s_paired_gu_test.cpp']=m.sha(p);r['source_pins']=pins
  r['test_adjustment']='Bit-cast float bits to uint32 for exact comparisons, including signed zeros; no numeric-equality weakening.'
  assert not run('base-status',['/usr/bin/git','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all'],BASE)[1].strip()
  assert run('base-head',['/usr/bin/git','rev-parse','HEAD'],BASE)[1].strip()=='0691bcdf5af63a85b3b25650f367d3276db64035'
  for mode in ['free','contrib-llvm','free-asan']:
   build=W/'build'/('cpu-'+mode)
   run('cpu-reconfigure-'+mode,['/usr/bin/cmake','-S',str(W),'-B',str(build)])
   run('cpu-rebuild-'+mode,['/usr/bin/cmake','--build',str(build),'--parallel','4','--target','cpu_job_histogram_test','iq3s_paired_gu_test'])
   for target in ['cpu_job_histogram_test','iq3s_paired_gu_test']:
    text=run('needed-'+mode+'-'+target,['/usr/bin/readelf','-d',str(build/target)])[1]
    assert not re.search(r'NEEDED.*(sycl|ur_|ze_|cuda|hip|OpenCL|mkl)',text,re.I)
   env=dict(ENV,STRATA_IQ256_PAIRED_GU='1')
   if mode=='free-asan':env.update(ASAN_OPTIONS='detect_leaks=1:halt_on_error=1',UBSAN_OPTIONS='halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1')
   run('affected-cpu-'+mode,['/usr/bin/ctest','--test-dir',str(build),'--output-on-failure','-R','^(cpu_job_histogram_(off|on)|iq3s_paired_gu_test)$'],env=env)
   for setting in ['0','1']:
    run('actual-paired-'+mode+'-'+setting,[str(build/'iq3s_paired_gu_test')],env=dict(env,STRATA_IQ256_GATHER=setting))
   r.setdefault('affected_cpu_binaries',{})[mode]={target:ident(build/target) for target in ['cpu_job_histogram_test','iq3s_paired_gu_test']}
  save()
  tar=BASE/'build/contrib-llvm/_deps/strata_onemath-subbuild/strata_onemath-populate-prefix/src/xestrata-3.tar.gz'
  assert tar.is_file();r['onemath_archive']=ident(tar)
  for mode,license in [('free','free'),('contrib-llvm','contrib')]:
   build=W/'build'/mode
   args=['/usr/bin/cmake','-S',str(W),'-B',str(build),'-G','Ninja','-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release','-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER='+str(T/'bin/clang++'),'-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER='+str(T/'bin/clang'),'-DSTRATA_LICENSE='+license,'-DSTRATA_ENABLE_XE=ON','-DSTRATA_CUDA_ARCHS=','-DSTRATA_HIP_ARCHS=','-DSTRATA_ONEMKL='+('ON' if mode=='contrib-llvm' else 'OFF'),'-DSTRATA_PORTABLE=OFF','-DSTRATA_BUILD_TESTS=ON','-DSTRATA_WERROR=ON','-DSTRATA_GGML_DIR='+str(GGML),'-DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON']
   if mode=='contrib-llvm':args+=['-DSTRATA_ONEMATH_SOURCE='+tar.as_uri(),'-DMKL_ROOT=/opt/intel/oneapi/mkl/2026.1']
   run('configure-'+mode,args,wall=300)
   run('build-'+mode,['/usr/bin/cmake','--build',str(build),'--parallel','4','--target','strata'],wall=700)
   r['builds'][mode]=dict(binary=ident(build/'strata'),cache=ident(build/'CMakeCache.txt'),compile_db=ident(build/'compile_commands.json'),runtime_tested=False);save()
  files=sorted(pins)
  existing={name:BASE/name for name in files if (BASE/name).is_file()}
  maps={}
  for name,p in existing.items():
   maps[name]={}
   for a,z,n in difflib.SequenceMatcher(None,p.read_text().splitlines(),(W/name).read_text().splitlines(),autojunk=False).get_matching_blocks():
    for i in range(n):maps[name][z+i+1]=a+i+1
  db=out/'baseline-db';db.mkdir()
  rows=[]
  for row in json.loads((W/'build/free/compile_commands.json').read_text()):
   path=Path(row['file'])
   if not path.is_relative_to(W):continue
   relative=str(path.relative_to(W))
   if relative not in existing:continue
   def adapt(value):
    for area in ['src','include','tools','tests','third_party']:
     value=re.sub(re.escape(str(W/area))+r'(?=/|$)',str(BASE/area),value)
    return value
   row['file']=str(existing[relative]);row['arguments']=[adapt(x) for x in row.get('arguments',shlex.split(row.get('command','')))];row.pop('command',None);rows.append(row)
  (db/'compile_commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
  baseline=next(c for c in prior['commands'] if c['label']=='baseline-lints');assert m.closed(baseline) and baseline['exit_code']==1

   name='baseline-lints.'+suffix;assert m.sha(logs/name)==baseline['logs'][name]['sha256']

  candidate,cso,cse=run('candidate-lints',['/bin/bash','tools/lint/run.sh',*files],env=dict(ENV,STRATA_LINT_BUILD=str(W/'build/free')),wall=700,allowed=(0,1))
  for name in ['clang-tidy','cppcheck','cmake-lint','codespell','reuse']:
   assert '== '+name in bso and '== '+name in cso
  assert 'skipped (' not in bso+cso and 'possible secret' not in bso+cso

   path,line,msg=row[1:]
   hit=re.match(r"warning: Excessive padding in 'struct strata::core::ExpertDispatch' \((\d+) padding bytes, where (\d+) is optimal\)",msg)
   if path!='include/strata/core/expert_source.hpp' or not hit:continue
   match=[x for x in before if x[1]==path and x[2]==line and "Excessive padding in 'struct strata::core::ExpertDispatch'" in x[3]]
   assert len(match)==1

   excess=int(hit[1])-int(hit[2]);old_excess=int(old_hit[1])-int(old_hit[2])
   padding.append(dict(path=path,original_declaration_line=line,old_actual=int(old_hit[1]),old_optimal=int(old_hit[2]),new_actual=int(hit[1]),new_optimal=int(hit[2]),old_excess=old_excess,new_excess=excess,not_worsened=excess<=old_excess))

Unchanged named Options/Verifier excess padding may not increase.')

 except BaseException as e:r['error']=repr(e);r['traceback']=traceback.format_exc()
